name: voice.elevenlabs-voices
title: Voices (ElevenLabs)
summary: List the ElevenLabs voices available to the key, optionally filtered by a search string. Optional provider: it needs an elevenlabs_api_key secret file and network access.
description: Returns the ElevenLabs voices the key can use, with their ids, names and labels, so an agent can pick a voice_id for voice.elevenlabs. Reads the elevenlabs_api_key secret file; the key is never logged or returned. Retries 429, 5xx and network errors.

search.description: Optional search term to filter voices by name or label; omit to list all available voices.

voices.description: The voices available to the key, each with its id, name and labels.

voice_id.description: Voice id to pass to voice.elevenlabs.

labels.description: Voice labels such as gender, age, accent or use case.
